title: A walk inside a walk's condition
notes: Airports with a route to an airport in Japan: the target's condition walks again, and `&&` joins it with a test on the root's own country (zega#86).

knownFailure.reason: zegadb/zega#86: the pinned engine (2b5ebd2) has no walk in a condition and no @count; this case records its outcome until the pin moves.
